function.name: pai_notebook_ops
function.description: Query and manage the per-project Research Brain vault. Use for external knowledge: RFCs, papers, API docs, web articles, Living ADRs, and evidence notes. Backed by human-readable Markdown files in <EXECUTION_DIR>/.project/research/.

action.description: Operation to perform. list_notebooks: list all notebooks. create_notebook: create a new notebook by name. search: full-text search across notebook content. add_note: save text content as a permanent note. add_source_url: ingest a URL (article, doc, RFC) into a notebook. poll_source_status: check async ingestion status of a source. get_source: retrieve full extracted text of a source. add_source_file: upload a local file (PDF, markdown, etc.) as a source. ask_notebook: grounded RAG query across notebook sources/notes. get_notebook: fetch notebook metadata including source/note IDs.

notebook_id.description: Target notebook ID (e.g. 'notebook:abc123'). Required for search, add_note, add_source_url, add_source_file, ask_notebook.

query.description: Search query string (for search action) or question (for ask_notebook action).

title.description: Title for add_note, add_source_url, or add_source_file actions.

content.description: Text content to save as a note (for add_note action).

url.description: URL to ingest as a source (for add_source_url action).

source_id.description: Source ID (e.g. 'source:abc123') for poll_source_status and get_source actions.

file_path.description: Path to file inside container (e.g. /opt/data/whitepaper.pdf) for add_source_file action.

answer_model.description: Optional answer model override for ask_notebook action.

function.name: pai_adr_ops
function.description: Create and verify Living Architecture Decision Records (L-ADRs). Tracks code symbol references with SHA-256 hashes to detect when architecture decisions drift from active codebase implementations. Actions: create_adr, check_drift, list_adrs.

action.description: Operation to perform: create_adr (scaffold a new living ADR with symbol hashes), check_drift (scan existing ADRs and verify if referenced code symbols have changed), list_adrs (list all ADRs and their status).

adr_number.description: ADR number, e.g. '001' or '002' (required for create_adr).

title.description: ADR title, e.g. 'Use Redis for Distributed Caching' (required for create_adr).

decision.description: The decision reached and rationale (for create_adr).

symbols.description: List of symbol references to anchor and hash, formatted as '@symbol:path/to/file.ext:SymbolName' (for create_adr).

execution_dir.description: Optional project execution directory path (e.g. /opt/data/workspace/my-project). Defaults to finding .project/planning directory under workspace.

function.name: pai_ops_design_ops
function.description: Manage OpenDesign projects via the daemon REST API. Use for: create_project, import_folder, list_projects, get_project, get_status, health. Projects are rooted at OD_WORKSPACE (default /opt/data/workspace). All actions are audited.

path.description: Folder path relative to workspace (required for import_folder)

function.name: pai_terrain_ops
function.description: Code intelligence over the Terrain index service. Terrain scans a project repo into .terrain/ (Markdown knowledge docs + agent context); this tool triggers those scans and reads the result. Check action='projects' first: if the repo is indexed, this is far more precise than grep; if it is not, fall back to grep + targeted reads. Indexing ('index', 'refresh') makes NO LLM call and costs nothing. Only 'ask' and 'init' use an LLM — Terrain's keyless Zen models, not the llm-gateway — and the service refuses them unless TERRAIN_ALLOW_LLM=1. Write scope: each scan writes .terrain/ inside the repo you pass. Paths are resolved inside /opt/data/workspace; other paths are rejected. Allowed actions: index, refresh, search, read, overview, projects, unregister, source, init, ask.

path.description: Repo directory to index, relative to /opt/data/workspace or absolute within it (e.g. 'github.com/ayedaemon/pai-stack'). Required for 'index', 'refresh', 'init'. Optional for 'source'.

slug.description: Registry name for this project. Defaults to the directory name.
